registerShipmentInstructions: Register your shipment yourself on Omniva's own site/app (no account with us needed there), then paste the barcode it gives you below. That barcode is what the parcel machine scans when you drop your toy off - saving it here turns it into a QR code you can pull up on your phone at the machine, and lets us know both sides have registered before either of you ships.

tipPrompt: Your toy was confirmed received! If ToyTrader was useful to you, you're welcome to leave an entirely optional 1 EUR tip - totally your call either way.
cannotCancelAnymore: This trade can no longer be cancelled - a toy is already on its way.
confirmCancel: Cancel this trade? This cannot be undone.
enterBarcodeFirst: Enter the barcode Omniva gave you first.
invalidBarcode: That doesn't look like a real Omniva barcode - it should be 5-30 characters.
